text:
Morgan S: quick heads-up — we're planning a base-image rebuild for the runtime fleet next Tue-Wed to pick up glibc hotpatch and slimlayer changes. Need to coordinate RBAC, KMS signing, and audit log routing.
Sam R: thanks — what's the proposed signer/key flow? are we switching to envelope encryption with customer KMS or using our internal signer? :thinking_face:
Morgan S: plan A is to keep internal cosign signer but rotate to a new keyring wrapped by GCP KMS. Plan B (if customers request) is an external customer-managed key option.
Ciara: from infra side we need explicit kube RBAC changes for the signer job SA — currently it has broad registry-write perms. We should tighten to a granular `image/sign` role.
Sam R: agree. can you paste the minimal RoleBinding you'd like?
Ciara: ```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: image-signer
  namespace: infra-batches
rules:
- apiGroups: ["registry.redwood.internal"]
  resources: ["images/sign"]
  verbs: ["create", "get"]
```
Lee-oncall: FYI the oncall checklist needs an audit log verification step — after the rebuild we must confirm every signed image event emits to the audit pipeline and is immutable for 90d.
Morgan S: yes — audit-bot will be configured to forward to the security SIEM. audit-bot, can you confirm the schema we expect?
audit-bot: schema v2 confirmed — fields: subject, action, image_digest, cosign_key_id, kms_key_id, timestamp, sig_metadata. Use JSONL -> pubsub -> SIEM.
Sam R: two questions: 1) does the signer rotate require a trust anchor update in the runtime nodes? 2) whats the fallback if KMS is throttled during signing?
Morgan S: 1) yes, the new public key will be distributed via the runtime-configmap with a rolling restart window. 2) fallback: a short-lived emergency key cached in HSM, but only allowed for N minutes and audited heavily. We're trying to avoid frequent fallback.
Ciara: about RBAC — need to ensure the deployment pipeline's CI runner cannot directly push signed images; only the signer job in infra-batches should be allowed. That means removing `image/sign` from the CI service account.
Sam R: noted — I'll open a tiny PR to remove that perm and add the new RoleBinding for signer. PR will reference this thread.
Lee-oncall: vulnerability triage — which CVE prompted this? I saw glibc CVE-2026-1234 flagged in staging. Is it only glibc or are there other deps?
Morgan S: primarily glibc + a handful of out-of-date curl versions in a few helper images. We'll bump glibc and rebuild all runtime bases; helper images get parallel minor builds.
Sam R: estimated rollout impact? latency-wise we should stagger across zones to keep tail latency < 50ms.
Ciara: re: KMS throttling — we'll add a small token bucket in the signer service and a queue with TTL. If it fills, signer returns `429` and CI will retry with exponential backoff. We should also instrument sign latency in the metrics dashboard.
Morgan S: good. action items: 1) Sam open PR to remove CI sign perms and add Role/RoleBinding for signer. 2) Ciara update signer to use wrapped KMS key + token bucket + metrics. 3) Lee add audit verification steps to oncall playbook. 4) Morgan publish final rollout window and publish trust anchor rotation steps.
Sam R: I'll push the PR today, ping @ciara when it's ready for infra review.
Ciara: will review, also adding a preflight job that asserts `audit-bot` receives a synthetic sign event before we cut traffic.
Lee-oncall: add a runbook step to check SIEM ingestion for `cosign_key_id` values post-rollout.
build-bot: deploy-checklist created: https://redwood.internal/infra/rebuild-checks/1812349999
Morgan S: thanks — tagging @oncall for Tuesday window. anyone object to a 02:00-06:00 UTC window?
Sam R: fine for runtime workloads. :thumbsup:
Ciara: OK. I'll schedule the keywrap rotation for 01:45 so signer switches before 02:00.
Lee-oncall: I'll be on pager for the window. I'll also add a postmortem stub in case of regressions.
Morgan S: perfect — will follow up with a short changelog and the PR links in this thread. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
